remediation.suggestion: Remove generated evaluation artifacts from the published skill package, or clearly separate them from skill instructions and audit inputs.

content.value_statement: Stripe integrations can become risky when teams choose deprecated APIs or the wrong checkout model. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code toward current Stripe patterns and official documentation.
actual_capabilities: Recommends Checkout Sessions for standard on-session payment flows.
Explains when PaymentIntents, SetupIntents, Payment Links, Invoicing, or Billing APIs fit better.
Guides migration away from Charges, Sources, Tokens, and legacy card collection patterns.
Advises on dynamic payment methods and Payment Element customization tradeoffs.
Provides Connect guidance for direct charges, destination charges, merchant of record, and capabilities.
Points users to official Stripe documentation for deeper implementation details.
limitations: Does not execute Stripe API calls or inspect live account settings.
Does not replace PCI compliance, tax, legal, or security review.
Does not provide complete application code or framework-specific implementation files.
Cannot guarantee linked Stripe guidance remains unchanged after publication.

use_cases.title: Plan checkout payments
use_cases.description: Choose Checkout, embedded Checkout, or Payment Element for a new web payment flow.

use_cases.title: Design recurring billing
use_cases.description: Select Billing and subscription patterns before building invoices, trials, upgrades, or renewals.

use_cases.title: Choose Connect flows
use_cases.description: Compare direct and destination charges while clarifying liability, merchant of record, and capabilities.

prompt_templates.title: Choose payment flow
prompt_templates.prompt: I am adding Stripe payments to a web app. Help me choose between Checkout, embedded Checkout, Payment Element, and PaymentIntents.

prompt_templates.title: Plan subscription billing
prompt_templates.prompt: I run a SaaS product with monthly plans, trials, and upgrades. Which Stripe Billing patterns should I use?

prompt_templates.title: Review custom checkout
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my proposed custom checkout architecture. Identify deprecated Stripe APIs, PCI concerns, and safer alternatives.

prompt_templates.title: Design Connect platform
prompt_templates.prompt: I am building a marketplace with connected accounts. Recommend a Connect charge flow and explain merchant-of-record and liability tradeoffs.

output_examples.input: I want to use the Charges API for a new one-time payment flow.
output: Use Checkout Sessions or PaymentIntents for new one-time payment flows.
Plan a migration from Charges before adding new payment features.
Use SetupIntents when saving payment methods for later use.

output_examples.input: My SaaS product needs subscriptions, trials, and plan upgrades.
output: Start with Stripe Billing and subscription use cases, not direct PaymentIntent-only flows.
Use Checkout with Billing when the standard hosted flow fits.
Model upgrades, renewals, invoices, and cancellation states before implementation.

output_examples.input: I am launching a marketplace that routes funds to sellers.
output: Choose direct charges when Stripe should own more account risk.
Choose destination charges when the platform accepts more balance liability.
Do not mix charge types without a defined fund-flow model.

best_practices: Prefer Checkout Sessions for standard on-session payments and subscriptions.
Use dynamic payment methods instead of hardcoded payment method type lists.
Check official Stripe documentation before relying on legacy API behavior.
anti_patterns: Building new integrations on Charges, Sources, Tokens, or legacy Card Element patterns.
Collecting raw card data server-side without verified PCI requirements and approvals.
Mixing Connect charge flows without clear liability and merchant-of-record ownership.

faq.question: Can this skill call Stripe APIs?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance only and does not make network calls or access Stripe accounts.

faq.question: Does it generate production-ready code?
faq.answer: No. It helps choose Stripe patterns, but implementation needs project-specific code, tests, and review.

faq.question: Which Stripe API does it prefer for checkout?
faq.answer: It prefers Checkout Sessions for standard on-session payments and subscriptions.

faq.question: When should I use PaymentIntents?
faq.answer: Use PaymentIntents for off-session payments or custom flows that need direct payment state control.

faq.question: Can it help with Stripe Connect?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains direct charges, destination charges, merchant of record, capabilities, and platform liability tradeoffs.

faq.question: Does it replace compliance review?
faq.answer: No. PCI, tax, legal, and security decisions still need qualified review.
